title: Valid Palindrome IV
summary: Given a 0-indexed string s consisting solely of lowercase English letters, you can change any character in s to any other character in one or two operations.
statement: Given a 0-indexed string s consisting solely of lowercase English letters, you can change any character in s to any other character in one or two operations. Determine whether it is possible to make s a palindrome through these operations, and return true if it is possible, or false otherwise.
constraints: In one operation, change any character to another lowercase letter.
Return whether the string can become a palindrome using at most two changes.
A mirrored mismatch needs exactly one change; matching pairs need none.
hints: Compare characters in mirrored positions from the two ends.
Each mismatched pair can be repaired with one character change.
Count mismatched pairs and accept when the count is at most two.
Pairs are independent: every mismatch requires one change and one change always repairs it, so the mismatch count is the exact minimum.
editorial: Pairs are independent: every mismatch requires one change and one change always repairs it, so the mismatch count is the exact minimum.
